latest_failure_investigation.observed: Premature PID3 clean exit and first retirement succeeded. Second startup stalled during PID2 Files after pixel denial checks. HMP reports running, CPL0 RIP ffffffff80021cba; addr2line against retained exact kernel ELF resolves to boot::validated_map_count. Repeated full-map validation inside each frame query is a concrete performance bottleneck and plausible contributor, not yet proven sole cause.
latest_failure_investigation.fix: Reuse complete map validation once per live frame query, then locally validate individual entries; preserve kind, bounds, corruption checks and no cache. Add three host regression tests. Existing 45s timeout and acceptance criteria unchanged; exact-head QEMU pending.
